en-US.title: Backgammon Mastermind
en-US.subtitle: Classic board game, refined
en-US.promoText: Play backgammon vs AI or pass-and-play. No account required.
en-US.description:
Backgammon Mastermind is a polished take on the classic strategy board game.

Play against a computer opponent or share the board with a friend in pass-and-play mode. Roll dice, move your checkers, hit blots, and bear off all fifteen to win.

Features:
• vs Computer with heuristic AI
• Local 2-player mode
• Direction overlay and game preferences
• Dark theme and English / Arabic support
• No account, no ads, no data collection — gameplay stays on your device

Perfect for quick matches and sharpening your backgammon skills.
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial TestFlight release of Backgammon Mastermind.

review.notes: Backgammon Mastermind is a single-player / local multiplayer board game. No login is required. Open the app, tap "vs Computer" or "2 Players", then roll dice and move checkers. All game logic runs locally on device.
